text: Website: Facebook tab phone scroll-trap fix and shorter Discord panels published live.
New automation: daily AI digest posts in #cyberchat at 6pm ET, recapping the Reddit feed, new Fan Edit Central Database entries, and new collection files.
Digest fixes: script now picks the current Gemini model automatically (Google retired the old names) and uses the correct #cyberchat channel.
The 9am collection notifier now logs every posted file (name + timestamp) so the daily digest can include new collection files.
Digest format finalized: bold '@FanEditFanClub Daily Bot Channel Recap' headline with clickable tag, one casual paragraph, no bullets or links.
Digest workflow gained one-off post inputs (manual_message + manual_channel) for announcements to any channel.
Cross-posting automation renamed to 'Facebook Group Auto Sharing' and moved from 6pm to 5:30pm ET daily.
Daily changelog automation moved into its own repo (fanedit-daily-changelog); posts release-notes bullets to #discord-moderators at 9pm ET.
Renamed the monthly dead-shortcut cleanup to 'Collection Cleanup' and moved its run to midnight on the 1st of each month.
Renamed the weekly access requests to 'Auto Request Access to Collection Files' and moved its run to Mondays at 6:30 AM ET.
Renamed the Weekly Fan Edit Catalog to 'The Workprint and Fanedit Appreciation Society Facebook Group Scraper' (schedule unchanged, Mondays 9 AM ET).
Fixed the 9am collection notifier's X posts: Buffer rejected a 276-char post as over 280, so X threads now split at a safer 240-char limit; this morning's 6-file batch was reposted to X (3 posts).
The 9am collection notifier now posts multi-part X batches as one real thread (each post replies to the previous, with 1/3, 2/3 numbering kept) instead of separate standalone posts.
Tightened the 9am notifier's X thread format: continuation posts (2/3, 3/3…) now list just the filenames and end with the 'See Folder…' sign-off instead of repeating the announcement header.

Website: fixed finicky phone scrolling on the social feeds block — feed cards no longer trap swipes in nested scroll boxes, fewer posts render on small screens, hover tooltips disabled on touch; desktop layout unchanged. Also fixed the Website icon link.

Website: homepage header now uses the cover GIF with the Fan Edit Fan Club title baked into the image, so the title stays on one line on phones; removed the separate overlaid text title. Desktop look unchanged.
Website: refreshed the homepage header GIF (v2) — removed the dark band behind the title, the Fan Edit Fan Club title now sits directly on the collage with outline/shadow.
Website: brightened the homepage header GIF (v3) — Sites dims the banner, so the brightness is now baked into the image; white title, brighter collage.
Website: toughened the Fan Editors X list embed — it now auto-retries loading up to 3 times and shows a Try-again fallback card instead of a blank space when X flakes.
Website: switched off Google Sites readability dimmer on the homepage header — the cover GIF now shows at full brightness with a white title.
Reddit pipeline migrated off RSS (dead 2026-11-13): daily 5pm ET browser scan publishes the listing JSON; digest reads it; posters relay each item 24h after its Reddit timestamp.

Fixed the daily Discord digest headline rendering as literal ** asterisks (Oct 8-10): the AI recap model started mangling the headline markup, so digest.py now has the model write only the paragraph and prepends the bold headline deterministically.

Automation: pruned 30 dead entries from the weekly access-request queue (verified 'file does not exist' two weeks straight) — the Monday 6:30am run now also clears its own dead links before each scan.

Website: Facebook group feed widget rebuilt from scratch — the fresh widget pulls 12 current posts (Oct 19-20) and the new embed id is live in both site files; syncs every 48 hours (SociableKIT free-plan limit), next Thursday.
Website: new self-hosted Threads and Instagram feed cards live on the homepage in the X-card style, refreshing every morning ~7:41am — no paid widgets needed.

Automation: launched the Daily TBC Mover — 6am ET daily moves items from '04 - To Be Catalogued' into the Collection root (69 on the first run Oct 19, 33/day after), renaming Monday refills and creating actor/director/franchise/series folder shortcuts; skips DeMeNtEd DeReK items; stays on permanently when TBC runs dry.
Website: Facebook tab now shows the Threads and Instagram cards, the group card got the missing 'Join Group' button matching the Page card, and the donation card text centers properly on mobile.

New automation: the official Discord blog is now watched daily and new posts (feature launches, changelogs, patch notes, safety updates) are posted to #discord-moderators via the Optimus bot, so the mod team sees Discord platform updates as they drop.
FEFC Collection app: new OnLive-style intro, tilted Home grid, moving fan edit clips on edge tiles, top bar with every Home section, New Arrivals sorted by date, and a centered Read First doc.
FEFC Collection app: posters on fan edit tiles, photos on Actor and Director tiles, and separate Collections and Fan Edits sections inside folders.
Automation: Collection File Notifier posts now leave out file extensions on every channel (Drive file names keep them).

Automation: the Reddit feed poster, Collection File Notifier and Central Database poster now also post to the Fan Edit Fan Club Threads account via Buffer, in the same format as X (threaded when over 500 characters).
Email: new Fan Edit Fan Club email signature with logo and linked channel icons, live in Gmail and Apple Mail.
Website: FB Page and FB Group buttons on the Facebook tab now match in size, and the Threads and Instagram cards got the same icon/name/button header as the Facebook cards.
Website: removed all links to the banned u/FanEditFanClub Reddit profile from the channel grid; the Reddit community and Reddit feed links stay.

Automation: the Daily Bot Channel Recap now ends with bullets counting new fan edits (linking #🗂️fan-edit-fan-club-collection) and new Central Database rows (linking #🪭 fan-edit-central-database), with no direct links to fan edit files.

Discord: the Collection bot is now named Fan Edit Optimus and answers questions when @mentioned or DMed, powered by free Gemini; in public channels it never posts cloud-storage links (Drive, Dropbox, MEGA, etc.) and points people to DM it or react with 📇, while Reddit, fanedit.org, YouTube and Vimeo links are allowed. The bot's role was given Manage Server so it can follow the server's AutoMod keyword list.
Fan Edit Optimus Discord Q&A switched to a current Gemini model so answers work again.

Discord collection DM now says over 5,000 files.

Fixed the 9am collection notifier to honor announcement preconditions: migrated shortcuts are no longer posted as new files. This morning's misfire was cleaned up across Discord (226 posts), X (25), Facebook Page (1), and Threads (1).

title: Blank Home fix + OnLive mosaic atlas (web+TV parity)
summary: Bundle-first catalog + #hub .mc watchdog; single ffmpeg mosaic-atlas 720/1080 with still fallback; Fire WebView HA/Range; videoTiles=1 LOW/MID. TV-only: update/VLC/native intro. Cold starts 10/10. APK on R2 (sha 36ed983a…).

text: FEFC Collection 0.8.19 (Fire TV vc29): show installed version next to Check for updates; restore Sign in with Google on Sync My List (above 6-digit sync code) on Fire TV and web — device-code when Worker has TV OAuth, else QR+phone Google Approve. No Drive content/sharing changes.

FEFC Collection 0.8.21 (Fire TV vc31): Open in VLC brings VLC's video activity to the foreground (video+audio); WebView ambience/atlas/<video> paused before launch. Includes 0.8.20: web player uses /api/stream only (no Drive preview / sign-in gate); Silk Open stream / Open in Drive after 8s. APK on R2 sha256 4d15bd89381133d26a891ff3e905e6feb8858cc59457bb64ce3519c2020d8029 size 106685074; is.gd/JZXvKZ → collection APK; PR #2 merged. No Drive/secrets/DNS changes.

FEFC Collection 0.8.22 (Fire TV vc32): built-in player uses /api/stream only (no Google account); full-screen ExoPlayer incl. .mkv; VLC-style controls on TV and web; sync pairing + My List persist across APK updates (native prefs, no WebView storage wipe) and restore from server by device id; home atlas aligned to hub tile grid. Same signing key as vc31. APK on R2 sha256 04c0e02ed1ee651fa0fd273fd002e94d72797d7d0da5c18e2ecb9dcc41af677a size 104829191; is.gd/JZXvKZ → collection APK (sha verified); PR #3 merged (f162089). No Drive/secrets/DNS changes.

FEFC Collection 0.8.23 (vc33): genres now cover nearly the whole catalog with multi-genre support, top menu reachable from video details, Fire TV header/search-keyboard/background-tile fixes, My List sync re-link prompt, VLC and player-control fixes. Outland fan edit added.

FEFC Collection 0.8.24 (vc34): browse the whole collection in VLC from one URL (collection.faneditfanclub.com/vlc.m3u) with genres, collections and sub-collections, generated from the live catalog; catalog now refreshes daily.

Kodi add-on + repository (plugin.video.fefc 1.1.0 / repository.fefc 1.0.0) live at fefc-collection.pages.dev/kodi-repo/; first branded FEFC Kodi app (Kodi 21.3 armv7, full-bleed banner/icon, add-ons preinstalled) at /kodi-app/FEFC-Kodi.apk; /vlc playlist endpoints removed; catalog-snapshot.yml now refreshes catalogue + artwork/descriptions/ratings/genres daily (free GitHub Action).
Fan Edit Fan Club collection notifier: Facebook and Discord posts now list new files as a numbered list, one per line, with the same intro and footer; X and Threads unchanged.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.1 Beta: selecting a movie or episode opens its details page first (Play is a button there), and search results open without the keyboard popping back up.
FEFC Kodi 0.3.2 Beta: home back to the web app's 3x3 tile grid with Search/Settings/About in a top bar; Read Me no longer spells out links and now says 6,000 files (web Read Me updated too).
FEFC Kodi 0.3.3–0.3.4 Beta: news ticker shows Discord, Facebook, X and Reddit icons like the web app; Link My List QR code now renders on Fire TV and the link text is shortened to fit.

FEFC Kodi 0.3.5–0.3.6 Beta: news ticker shows each post's Discord, Facebook, X or Reddit icon right before it, like the web app; Link My List QR code is now a full-colour image on white (fixes the black square on Fire TV), with a web fallback.

FEFC Kodi 0.3.7 Beta: the top bar (version, Search, Settings, About, clock) and the community ticker with icons now show on every page, hidden during fullscreen video; Link My List QR loads from the web on a white background with the full link shown underneath.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.8 Beta: Link My List popup now only opens when you pick it and no longer reappears on Home; 'Link My List' item when unlinked; once-per-session update prompt after the intro.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.9 Beta: Home tiles now show collection and file counts like the web app, and My List has a star with your starred count.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.10 Beta: Home tile counts now match the web app (Main Collection about 6,285 files, no double counting), and the app icon is back by the update button.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.11 Beta: fixes the blank FEFC icon/banner on the Fire TV home and apps row (each update now has its own Android version number).
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.12 Beta: Fire TV home tile banner set up like the original FEFC Fire TV app, so older Fire Sticks show FEFC art instead of a grey placeholder.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.13 Beta: Fire Stick home tile uses a plain FEFC icon (no more grey grid), and app updates download in one uninterrupted flow that resumes and retries by itself.

FEFC Kodi app 0.3.14 Beta: every release now builds two apps from the same source: the existing FEFC app keeps updating as before, and a new separate FEFC app for new installs installs alongside regular Kodi.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.15 Beta: the new FEFC app (FEFC.apk) now includes 64-bit Kodi so it installs on Pixel phones and tablets; the Fire TV app is unchanged.
FEFC Kodi app 0.3.16 Beta: fixes the launch crash in the new phone/tablet FEFC app (now app ID com.fefc.kodi); Fire TV app unchanged.
FEFC Kodi 0.3.17 Beta: full file titles like the web app (e.g. "- Fan Edit" endings kept); more room for long titles.

FEFC Kodi 0.3.18: LCARS details page like the web app; fan edit synopsis, ratings (IFDB, Movies Remastered) and changes list; Drive shortcut folders open as folders; Support Us / Read First docs shown in folders.

FEFC Kodi 0.3.19 Beta: franchise sound clip on every file details page; sound on/off toggle with speaker icon; search/settings icons; Home cleanup (Exit, logo, version text, Community label removed); update button shows Up To Date / Update Available and always checks fresh.

FEFC Kodi 0.3.20 Beta (build 26): Support Us Patreon/PayPal/Venmo icons with QR codes; phone edge-swipe Back pops history like the remote; folders, shortcuts, Shuffle Play, Sort and Support Us are landscape cards while video files stay portrait posters. Dual APKs published (legacy FEFC-Kodi.apk + FEFC.apk).

FEFC Kodi 0.3.21 Beta (build 27): phone/tablet Android notifications for app updates and new collection files (Settings → Notifications toggles, both default ON); new-files feed published with the daily social posts; Fire TV update popup unchanged.

FEFC Kodi 0.3.21 Beta (build 28) + web 0.8.26: news ticker on web and both Kodi packages shows newly added collection files from the same new-files.json feed the daily notifier publishes with its social posts; phone/tablet POST_NOTIFICATIONS asked once on first launch; first feed poll baselines without a stale blast. Dual APKs published (FEFC-Kodi.apk + FEFC.apk).

FEFC Kodi 0.3.22 Beta (build 33) + web 0.8.27: new details screen (LCARS font, high-contrast buttons, multi-column cast), Home button on every page's menu bar, file counts show only videos directly in each folder, folder sounds shuffle without back-to-back repeats, Verhoeven and Emmerich folder sounds fixed, files shown portrait and folders landscape.

FEFC Kodi 0.4.0 Beta (build 35) + web 0.4.0 (web and Kodi now share version numbers): old Fire TV ambience restored seamless, bottom bar fits the 3 tile columns, compact Up To Date box, mosaic tiles match the menu grid, tighter ticker with fixed social icons, official Patreon/PayPal/Venmo logos, no more Next Page, 79 trailer-thumbnail covers replaced with clean film stills, new shuffled movie sound clips, portrait search results for videos, star icon on Add to My List, and a File Info panel with length, size, resolution, format and host.
Fan Edit Fan Club collection notifier: Discord posts now use a compact numbered list — intro on its own line, one file per line with no blank lines between items.

FEFC web app + Kodi app updated to 0.4.1 (Kodi build 37): provider Play buttons fixed (mislabeled What If/X-Men record removed), search text-match warning restored, app feedback form + QR code added (web Support Us, Kodi About > Give feedback), contact email added.
Fan Edit Optimus now replies to Thread It re-posts and to replies to its own messages (e.g. the daily rules post) without needing an @mention.

Fan Edit Optimus: removed the last Grok bot references — the emoji-reaction DM and the bot's answers now point to Fan Edit Optimus itself, and the daily 9 AM rules post now ends with 'Got a question? Ask Fan Edit Optimus — tag me in a channel or DM me and I'll help.'

Fan Edit Optimus launched Editor Tips: a new tip for fan editors every Tuesday and Friday at 10:00 AM ET in #editors, starting with how to pick what movie or series to edit — and Optimus can now answer fan-editor questions (software, AI, Drive hosting, audio, color, exporting) in channels, DMs, and the website chat.

FEFC Kodi 0.5.5 Beta (build 47) shipped for Fire TV and phone/tablet, with repaired Home mosaic and intro Skip, continuous browsing ambience, readable labels and folder artwork, My List sort and video-only shuffle, square QR codes, and a silent Optimus Search animation.

FEFC app new-files feed caught up: republished new-files.json with the 141 Collection files added Nov 5–9, so app notifications and the news ticker show them again. Also corrected the notifier's Cloudflare account ID setting.

FEFC Collection site fixed: a stale deploy at 7:26 AM ET had replaced the live site with an Oct 21 build that had no worker, so the app's new-files feed, the Kodi repo and sync links showed the homepage. Rolled back, then redeployed current main, which also puts the restored per-file metadata live.

FEFC Kodi 0.6 Beta (build 48) shipped for Fire TV and phone/tablet: Back works on every screen again, the bottom menu is reachable from folders, Search is one bar with Optimus looping until you type, poster titles are larger and wrap, New Arrivals opens faster, videos without posters get fallback art, and QR codes carry the FEFC mark.
FEFC app 0.6.5 Beta shipped: About entries listed directly in Settings, FEFC logo baked into QR codes, Link My List shows FanEditFanClub.com/MyList, Samsung widget versioning fixed.
faneditfanclub.com/MyList now redirects to the collection's Link My List page.
FEFC 0.6.6 Beta: Claude code-review fixes (hundreds of bug fixes across the Kodi app), Mac full update popup, TV sign-in name fix and link-code rate limit.
